text_block_list.text:
Whoa... what a race! Нарита Брайан is
unstoppable!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: Awww... Ogurin lost...
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
To think she'd even take down Oguri! No
one can
get in her way!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text:
She's already at the Emperor's level—no,
maybe
even higher!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'll admit, you utterly defeated me.
Thanks for the
great race.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Hah... What are you saying? Your eyes
haven't
lost their spirit yet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That doesn't change that I lost, and now
you'll go
on ahead of me.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: The other day...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I heard Симболи Рудольф is racing in the
next Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: She's strong. Much stronger than me.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
You can't afford to let your guard down.
She's the
undefeated Triple Crown
Champion... the
Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: ...I know.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I am keenly aware of her strength. More
than
anyone.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And yet, you're still going after that
strength.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll get going, then. I've got to say
hello to
everyone...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: And let them know I'm not giving up.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф is running in the Japan
Cup,
right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A feature that aired on the news earlier
said as
much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: There you have it! Rudolf will be running!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
That's right. I will be competing in the
upcoming
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I understand Нарита Брайан will be
contending for
the Senior Autumn Triple
Crown, starting with the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've decided to take part in order to
meet her
head on.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ohhh!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Uh, in that case, would you say that
she's your
rival?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
I don't think "rival" is an accurate
description.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Let us just say that I'm simply... curious.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Between the current Brian and myself,
who will
prove themselves to be
stronger?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: "The current Brian," huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Your cool face is betraying your
excitement...
President.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Still... she's stronger than anyone else.
Turning tail
and running from this match
is not an option.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
She remains tense for some time
afterward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The second race of the Senior Autumn
Triple
Crown is the Japan Cup, where
the strongest
racers await us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
